audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells the player twice that he has no answer to Nether Grasp — spikes[1].text says 'your own ult can't out-tempo his lockdown' and mid says 'your own R can't answer a suppress-lock'. Nether Grasp is a channel, and Falling Star is a stun at 1250 range. The owner's ultimate cancels it.
audit.why: Enemy R: 'Malzahar channels the essence of the Void to suppress an enemy champion over a zone of damaging negative energy', range 700, cooldown 140/110/80, carrying both the hardCC and channel flags. Owner R: 'This impact deals magic damage and stuns enemies', range 1250. The brief's missingInteractions raises exactly this (channel-interruptible).
audit.corrected: Stated with the one condition that makes it true in practice — see the Void Shift finding below — in winCon, loading, breakdown.mid, report[5], spikes[1].text and mid.
sources: brief enemyKit R text and flags

audit.whatIsWrong: Void Shift is described as a 'spell shield' in tldr, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5] ('poke the spell shield BEFORE every trade', 'while his passive shield is intact'). It is not a spell shield — it is massive damage reduction plus crowd control immunity that any damage strips.
audit.why: Enemy passive: 'When he hasn't recently taken damage or been crowd controlled, Malzahar gains massive damage reduction and crowd control immunity, lingering for a short period after taking damage.' The distinction is load-bearing here, and it is the condition on the finding above: while Void Shift is up he is CC-immune, so Falling Star will NOT cancel his grasp. You must land damage first to strip it, and only then does the stun interrupt.
audit.corrected: Restated as damage reduction plus CC immunity throughout, and the sequencing spelled out: chip it off with a beam tick, then stun. That is the concrete 'wait for X before you Y' line the packet says is missing from this matchup.

audit.whatIsWrong: Wrong abilities in the content layer. whys[1] and spikes[0].text credit 'Void Swarm DoT' with grinding your HP — Void Swarm summons Voidlings, it has no damage over time; Malefic Visions (E) is the DoT. And the content layer names two Aurelion Sol abilities that do not exist: 'Q Starfire' (three places) and 'Voice of Light' as his ultimate (two places).
audit.why: Enemy W: 'Malzahar summons Voidlings to attack nearby enemies', range 150, 8s. Enemy E Malefic Visions: 'dealing damage over time... If the target dies while afflicted, they pass on to a nearby enemy unit', 650 range, 11/10/9/8/7. Owner kit is Breath of Light, Astral Flight, the black hole, and Falling Star / The Skies Descend — no Starfire, no Voice of Light.
audit.corrected: Void Swarm references replaced with Malefic Visions; every Starfire replaced with Breath of Light and every Voice of Light with The Skies Descend.

audit.whatIsWrong: The difficulty framing never names the thing that actually loses you the lane: Call of the Void's silence at 900 range on a 6-second cooldown, against a 750-range channelled beam. Silence also denies Astral Flight, so it removes your escape, not just your damage.
audit.why: Enemy Q: 'they fire projectiles that deal Magic Damage and silence enemy champions', range 900, cooldown 6 flat, silence flag. Owner Q carries the channel flag and Astral Flight is a cast, so a silence stops both.
audit.corrected: Call of the Void named as the lane's real clock in enemyWin, tradeBad, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.early, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1], report[5], report[9] and early — with the 6-second gap after it as the step-up window.

notes: The most important correction in this matchup: the page told the player twice, in spikes[1].text and mid, that his ultimate 'can't answer a suppress-lock'. Nether Grasp is a channel and Falling Star is a stun — the owner's ultimate cancels it. I did NOT write that as an unconditional claim, because Void Shift grants crowd control immunity until he takes damage, so the stun only interrupts once the passive has been chipped off. That ordering — damage first, then stun — is now the concrete sequencing line the packet says this matchup lacks. Void Shift was also miscalled a 'spell shield' in four fields; it is damage reduction plus CC immunity, which matters precisely because it changes whether your stun lands. The suspectName the packet flagged ('Nether Grasp's') is a FALSE POSITIVE — that is his real R. Third sighting of borrowed text from another champion's kit: 'Q Starfire' three times and 'Voice of Light' twice as Aurelion Sol's ultimate, matching the 'Voidlink' sightings in katarina/leblanc and the same two names in lux. Please grep the whole aurelionsol content file for Starfire, Voidlink and Voice of Light — the pattern spans at least four of my seven matchups, so it almost certainly reaches the ones I do not own. I moved the first-item row to Aurelion Sol in both layers as a matched pair and rewrote whys[5] to back it, moved the 2+ items row (its why already said so), and left level 6 with Malzahar with phases[4].why rewritten to justify it.
